answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Work waits on the raven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the voyage of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The copper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors.
